citation: Gibbs, Paul. "The Concept of Profound Boredom: Learning from Moments of Vision." Studies in Philosophy and Education 30 (2011): 601–613. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11217-011-9256-5
thesis: Profound boredom, Heidegger's third and deepest form (FCM), is not a pathology to be dispelled through busyness but a disclosive attunement that, via the Augenblick (moment of vision), opens authentic and edifying possibilities for learning in the workplace, classroom, and home; modern consumerist 'datable time' conceals rather than eliminates profound boredom, and formal education should therefore cultivate Rortyan 'edifying conversation' and Bildung rather than instrumental, metrics-driven instruction.

sections.title: Abstract + epigraph
sections.summary: Benjamin's 'dream bird' image of boredom frames the paper; boredom linked to postmodern consumerism and to Heidegger's account of mood, temporality, and the Augenblick.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.summary: Compressed history of boredom-and-modernity scholarship (acedia, Kierkegaard, McDonald, Simmel, Benjamin, Svendsen, Goodstein, Pezze & Salzani, Stafford & Gregory, Mansikka); explicit rejection of the mainstream educational-literature view (Breidenstein; Mann & Robinson; Belton & Priyadharshini) that boredom is a flaw correctable by more entertaining/technological teaching.

sections.title: Heidegger and the Experience of Boredom
sections.summary: Expository pass through FCM's three forms of boredom (bored-by, bored-with, profound 'one is bored'), culminating in a reproduction of FCM's own seven-point Table 1 comparison.

sections.title: The Moments of Vision as the Basis of Learning from Profound Boredom's Announcement of the Telling Refusal
sections.summary: The Augenblick's ecstatic, duration-bearing (non-instantaneous) character via McNeill, Blattner, and Dreyfus; the kairos/phronesis (practical wisdom) analogy; dunamis/energeia via Witt and Brogan.

sections.title: Listening to the Telling Refusal of Profound Boredom not Pushing it Away, a Way of Learning to be
sections.summary: Pedagogical uptake: learning cannot be reduced to instilled 'competencies'; direct quotation of FCM's own passage (matching fcm-07) on competencies vs. strength/power.

sections.title: The Moment of Vision as a Moment of Edification
sections.summary: Rorty's edification/ironist distinction imported to frame profound boredom's educational payoff against credentialed, commodified, market-driven schooling; Heidegger on education and Plato's cave.

sections.title: Concluding Comments
sections.summary: Call for formal education to embrace edifying conversation and Bildung-as-flourishing over an instrumental, quality-metrics-enframed model of education.

constructs.label: profound/deep boredom (FCM 3rd form)
constructs.treatment: central construct from p.606 onward: impersonal 'one is bored,' indifference enveloping beings as a whole, telling refusal disclosing unexploited possibilities

constructs.label: being-bored-by (1st form)
constructs.treatment: faithful exposition via 'confrontation with time' / 'driving away of boredom that drives time on'

constructs.label: being-bored-with (2nd form)
constructs.treatment: dinner-party example; 'standing of time' and 'prolonged now'; Boss's 'I bore myself' gloss

constructs.label: temporality of boredom (time-drag)
constructs.treatment: connective construct: datable/world time vs. originary temporality unified in the Augenblick

constructs.label: monotony/meaninglessness
constructs.treatment: Simmel's loss-of-identity-and-meaningfulness frame; 'a life going nowhere' for the second form

constructs.label: flow/engagement (contrast pole)
constructs.treatment: negative-only: busyness/consumerist distraction as the inauthentic evasion that forecloses profound boredom, not a positive engaged state

constructs.label: boredom-as-regulatory-signal (functional account)
constructs.treatment: philosophical/edifying functional reading only ('positive attunement'); explicitly distinct from an empirical/evolutionary regulatory theory

constructs.label: situational vs. trait/state boredom
constructs.treatment: loose structural analogue only (our own mapping of first/second-form situation-boundedness vs. third-form general disposition); not Gibbs's own vocabulary

readings.claim: First-form paraphrase (train-station 'confrontation with time,' time 'drags and paralyzes') tracks fcm-04's Hingehaltenheit analysis almost verbatim.
Second-form paraphrase (evening invitation, 'standing of time,' 'sets us in place') tracks fcm-05's evening-invitation/standing-time analysis closely.
Third-form treatment (das Man, indifference enveloping beings as a whole, telling refusal, Augenblick as resolute self-disclosure) tracks fcm-06's core third-form analysis.

The 'learned competencies... suffocation' quotation (p.610) reproduces FCM's Chapter Five §38a passage (fcm-07) on the absence of oppressiveness in contemporary Dasein almost verbatim -- a precise, previously unflagged locus match.

The Augenblick is extended, via Rorty's edification/ironist vocabulary and the kairos/phronesis analogy, into an explicit workplace/classroom pedagogy that FCM's own text (which stops at naming 'world') does not itself develop.

Gibbs's reference list appears to mis-key '1995a' (assigning it to Heidegger's Aristotle's Metaphysics Vols.1-3 lectures) even though his in-text '1995a' page citations for the three-forms material verifiably match FCM's own pagination.
readings.stance: citation-fidelity observation, not an interpretive claim

concepts.term: Leergelassenheit / Hingehaltenheit (being left empty / held in limbo)

interlocutors.name: Heidegger, Martin -- Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics
interlocutors.role: primary phenomenological source for the three forms of boredom and the Augenblick

interlocutors.name: Heidegger, Martin -- Being and Time
interlocutors.role: source for the Augenblick's definition (1962, p.387) and das Man

interlocutors.name: Dreyfus, Hubert (1992, 2004)
interlocutors.role: 'gestalt switch' gloss on falling-to-resoluteness; phronimos/resolute-individual analogy

interlocutors.name: McNeill, William (1999)
interlocutors.role: Augenblick's finite duration; 'learning to dwell' in the moment of vision

interlocutors.name: Blattner, William (2006)
interlocutors.role: 'moment of vision encompasses who I find myself to be' gloss

interlocutors.name: Boss, Medard (2009)
interlocutors.role: 'I bore myself' gloss and shared-constitution formula for forms one and two

interlocutors.name: Biceaga, Victor (2006)
interlocutors.role: 'having one's possibilities suspended' gloss on the third form

interlocutors.name: Rorty, Richard (1979, 1999)
interlocutors.role: edification/ironist framework imported to gloss profound boredom's pedagogical use

interlocutors.name: Witt, Charlotte (2003)
interlocutors.role: moment of vision's causal power read as independent of dunamis/energeia

interlocutors.name: Brogan, Walter (2005)
interlocutors.role: phronimos's capacity to 'call himself back resolutely'

interlocutors.name: Thomson, Iain (2005, cited as 'Thompson')
interlocutors.role: 'restoring meaning to increasingly formal and empty ideals' of contemporary education

interlocutors.name: Mansikka, J.-E. (2009)
interlocutors.role: prior education-sphere treatment of Heideggerian boredom, cited twice

interlocutors.name: Stafford, S.P. & Gregory, W.T. (2006)
interlocutors.role: cited bridge from phenomenology toward scientific investigation of conscious experience

tensions.note: Gibbs explicitly rejects Breidenstein (2007) and Mann & Robinson (2009)'s framing that boredom is a flaw solvable by more entertaining/technological teaching.

tensions.axis: instrumental, metrics-enframed education vs. edifying conversation / Bildung
tensions.note: the paper's closing recommendation opposes 'quality metrics' models of education to Rortyan edification and Bildung-as-flourishing.

tensions.axis: philosophical/edifying functional account of boredom vs. empirical/evolutionary-regulatory account (Elpidorou)
tensions.note: Gibbs's 'positive attunement' reading is existential-disclosive, not evolutionary-adaptive; should not be treated as the same construct as bor-sec-25/26's regulatory theory.
